title: NYC DOESN'T KNOW ITS OWN LAWS!
summary: Louis Rossmann recounts calling NYC's Department of Consumer Affairs after his repair business was fined, only to find the agency staff could not explain what the law required. The call starts around 3:14.
why: HN cites it as a concrete example of bureaucrats not knowing the rules they enforce on small businesses.

quote.text: Louis Rossmann did a pretty good job demonstrating a similar issue with New York
